title: q=4 apartment-code anchor and local theta cut-space theorem
purpose: Extend the Pass5051 q-family theta-code frontier to the first non-prime anchor q=4 and isolate the all-q local K_{q+1} cut-space mechanism behind theta relations.
boundary: The q=4 code is exact, and the local cut-space theorem is all-q. Full-dual generation and distance q^4 for arbitrary q remain unpromoted unless separately proved.
